4d2f72d8891a48c478eb7607f3ab79dd80728a69.LogDescription: Free the spirit of Anaya Dawnrunner and bring her pendant back to Cerellean Whiteclaw in Auberdine.
4d2f72d8891a48c478eb7607f3ab79dd80728a69.QuestDescription: In the aftermath of the battles at the Well of Eternity, I heard that Ameth'Aran had been destroyed, its people dead, including my love, Anaya.$b$bI would never have thought, thousands of years later, that memories of Anaya would still haunt my dreams. Wandering the woods of Darkshore in a stupor, I found myself in the ruins of Ameth'Aran... where I saw the haunted spirit of my beloved.$b$bShe must be freed, but I lack the heart to do it. Her spirit must be destroyed.

4d32af7727df223461dab0c8d4583e1a445b33ed.Text: If you're here, then it means you are prepared to begin the study of summoning demonic cohorts to do your bidding. We will start with the lowliest creatures you will be able to call and continue from there. Let us begin.

parent_quests.QuestDescription: Shaffar's ethereals have completely blocked us out of the Mana-Tombs. Thankfully, I've got a plan. While we can't go in through the front door, there are sure to be several transporters inside.$B$BI want you to clear the way for my crew first and then I want you to activate one of their transporters to teleport us inside.$B$BActivate the teleporter in the chamber right before Shaffar's chambers when the way has been cleared. Don't worry, I'll make it worth your while...

4d700597e15952a399f8fbbed3d09323235bedac.QuestDescription: One of the plague cauldrons is located in the field of a former farmhouse now referred to as Dalson's Tears. Use this bottle to obtain a sample from inside the cauldron; each cauldron has its own distinct brew of toxins it uses.

We must get our hands on that book, $N.$B$BIt's the key to unraveling the mystery of the raven god and preventing him from taking over the Emerald Dream.$B$BPerhaps Morthis will finally agree to take me as a student if we succeed!

4dbbe19c0af721bb539d52714a642201e0ad169a.LogDescription: Locate Beren's Peril, then kill 6 Ravenclaw Drudgers and 6 Ravenclaw Guardians, then return to Shadow Priest Allister at the Sepulcher.
4dbbe19c0af721bb539d52714a642201e0ad169a.QuestDescription: I have received reports that a group of undead are holing up to prepare for an attack against us. Armed with this information, we can turn the tables and attack them first, nipping their little plan in the bud.$b$bUnfortunately, my information is spotty, at best. They are reported to be hiding in a location known as Beren's Peril. The exact location is unknown, but it appears to be a cave in the hills, near a pocket of Dalaran wizards.$b$bI trust your resourcefulness. Find them, and put them down.
